'''SureGrip''' was a company that specialized in the production of a variety of devices used for climbing. Among these were [[FrictionGrip/Legends|FrictionGrip]], [[Climbing Syntherope]], and the [[Climbing Boot and Glove Set]].<ref name="ROE" />
